region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis medication reader HCIMDB01, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it opens a cursor over the patient's MEDICATION rows and loads each (up to 50) into the COMMAREA array. A patient with two or more rows is not driven: LOAD-COMMAREA stores entry n after setting CA-NUM-MEDICATIONS to n-1, a subscript past the ODO count that IBM (no SSRANGE) leaves undefined and GnuCOBOL refuses (register X8). Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). Derived from IBM's example-health-apis (github.com/ibm/example-health-apis, Apache-2.0; (C) Copyright IBM Corp. 2011, 2014): LICENSE here is the corpus's own, NOTICE names the source and what was derived.

scenarios.name: not-found

scenarios.name: no-commarea
